## What landed (engineering deliverables)

### 1. `resolution/src/resolution/partner_name_packet.py` (new, ~480 lines)

The committed OP-15 disposition packet generator
(`sig.partner-name-disposition-packet/1`):

- **`build_packet`** — the measured packet over a real
  `partner-name-audit` report: N (`legacy_keys`), the split/keep counts,
  `scoped_candidates_total`, distinct asserting sources, the
  split-count histogram, and the **OP-15 option blast radii** — `keep`
  (single-source keys), `split` (multi-source keys + their scoped
  candidates), `same_as` (`sized: false`, `keys: null` — this query
  carries no strong-identifier joinability; an honest null, never an
  invented count).
- **`build_queued_packet`** — the `prepared_not_executed` packet an
  OM-19 queued run commits: the same query + digest surface,
  `n`/`measured`/`report_sha256` null, `keys: []` — an absent hosted
  read is recorded, never fabricated as counted.
- **SIG-ENG-042 fail-loud:** a 0-key report raises
  `PartnerNamePacketError` (a vacuous N is never success);
  `--allow-empty` is the recorded escape for a spine that genuinely
  carries no legacy keys. An inconsistent report
  (`legacy_keys` ≠ impact rows) is refused — no smoothed count.
- **Part VIII:** per-key packet rows carry `entity_id` +
  `name_key_sha256` (the join digest back to the private report) +
  `source_count` + `split_count` only — no registrant name, label or
  free text reaches a committed artifact. The name-bearing report JSON
  stays in the gitignored `docs/build/logs/` tree.
- **Provenance:** the verbatim `_REPORT_SQL`, `query_sha256`
  (computed at generation time so the queued packet already pins what
  the re-run measures), `report_sha256` (canonical-JSON digest of the
  consumed report), `packet_sha256`, and the `date -u` bounds the
  runner recorded around the read.
- **`write_packet`** emits `packet.json` + `packet.sha256` +
  `PACKET.md` (+ `keys.csv` when measured).

### 2. CLI (`resolution/src/resolution/cli.py`)

- `partner-name-audit` gains `--dsn-env` (default
  `SIG_PARTNER_AUDIT_DSN` — env only; a DSN on argv leaks into the
  process list), `--role` (the apply leg `SET ROLE`s to
  `sig_read_public` — least privilege, inside the read-only
  transaction, never persisted), and `--out` (report path under the
  gitignored logs tree). The verb stays a single read-only transaction
  (`SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY`, rollback).
- New verb **`partner-name-packet`**: `--report <audit JSON>`
  (measured mode — needs `--started-at`/`--finished-at`, refuses
  without them) or `--queued` (needs `--planned-at`; a `date -u` stamp
  is required — records never invent a clock); `--spine` names the
  measured surface honestly; `--allow-empty` is the recorded
  vacuous-N escape; `--out-dir` the artifacts directory.

### 3. `ops/gcp/partner-name-audit.sh` (new, ~170 lines)

The scripted/recorded invocation, following the alerting.sh/db-logins.sh
conventions (config.sh + lib.sh, `_plan`/`_log`, `banner`,
`require_project`, `require_adc` exit 3):

- `--check` (default) — prints the whole plan (proxy leg, env
  requirements, the two `date -u` bounds, both CLI invocations, the
  packet artifacts, the ledger line, the verbatim re-run prompt),
  `check OK`, no ADC, no network.
- `--apply` — `require_project` + `require_adc` (exit 3 unarmed),
  refuses without `SIG_PARTNER_AUDIT_DSN` (env only — exit 3), starts
  `cloud-sql-proxy` on `127.0.0.1:${SIG_PROXY_PORT:-5433}` (stopped on
  exit via trap), records `T0`/`T1` `date -u` bounds around the audit
  read, runs `partner-name-audit --dsn-env … --role sig_read_public
  --out docs/build/logs/partner-name-audit/<ts>.json` then
  `partner-name-packet --report … --spine "sig-pg (read-only
  sig_read_public)" --started-at T0 --finished-at T1 --out-dir
  docs/build/reports/p35.21-partner-name-audit`, and prints the report
  + packet sha256 and the ledger line.
- No AR-3 window guard — a read binds no mutation window (the
  contract's Live window is none). Nothing writes to production: the
  audit is read-only by construction; the packet writes only
  committed-report bytes.

### 4. The committed packets (`docs/build/reports/p35.21-partner-name-audit/`)

- **Queued packet** (`packet.json` + `packet.sha256` + `PACKET.md`)
  — `status: prepared_not_executed`, `n: null`, `measured: null`, the
  queue record (reason, `date -u` planned-at, the env the re-run
  needs, the verbatim re-run prompt), and the verbatim query +
  `query_sha256 dcc24c34…` already pinned — nothing fabricated.
- **Fixture packet** (`fixture-spine/`) — the measured packet over a
  known fixture spine (3 legacy keys: two single-source, one
  three-source → 5 scoped candidates, split histogram `{1:2, 3:1}`),
  committed as the generator's worked example — clearly labelled
  `fixture-spine`, never presented as hosted evidence.
- `keys.csv` — header + per-key `entity_id`/`name_key_sha256`/counts
  rows only.
